notes: Starting cards as posted under 'starting (9)': Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Start Your Engines!, Boonta Eve Podrace, Watto's Box and Sebulba's Podracer; these count toward the 60. Posted 'jp audience chamber', 'bounta eve podrace', 'spaceportdocking bay.' and 'tatoine podrace arena' dested the Dark printings; 'tatoine jp' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'jp lower passage' dested Jabba's Palace: Lower Passages.

Posted 'bosk in hounds tooth' and 'fett in slave one' dested Bossk In Hound's Tooth and Boba Fett In Slave I; 'omni box / its worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'neimodian advisor' dested Neimoidian Advisor.
